one_line_description: Channel-based messaging platform for team collaboration
auth_methods_evidence: Authenticate your Web API requests by providing a [bearer token](/authentication/tokens), which identifies a single user or bot user relationship. [Register your application](https://api.slack.com/apps) with Slack to obtain credentials for use with our [OAuth 2.0](/authentication/installing-with-oauth) implementation
self_serve_evidence: Register your application with Slack to obtain credentials for use with our OAuth 2.0 implementation
buildability_rationale: Self-serve OAuth2 authentication with broad API surface and good documentation
agent_notes: Slack provides a comprehensive Web API with over 200 methods, supports OAuth2 authentication, and has good documentation. The Composio registry shows 158 tools available for integration.
verification_note: Note: agent found [api_key, oauth2] but Composio lists only [oauth2]. Slack supports bot tokens (xoxb-, which are API keys) AND OAuth2; Composio implements only OAuth2. Agent is correct.
